{{Quote|Jabba says you're good muscle. Well I need a rival gang roughed up. Think you can do that?|Niko Brehe, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:R" />}}
'''Niko Brehe''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They killed one of Jabba's couriers and stole some valuable Old Republic coins. Jabba wants them back.|Niko Brehe, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:R" />}}
Brehe worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], along with [[Vourk ver'Zremp]]<ref name="SWG:SW">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Short Walk|Tatooine}}</ref> and [[Dunir Signos]], under the orders of [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]].<ref name="SWG:R" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> one of Jabba's couriers was attacked by a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] and they stole some valuable [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] coins. Jabba wanted them back, so Brehe hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to attack the swoop gang and recover the coins. Brehe paid the spacer for this and then sent the spacer to speak to Dunir Signos about making a delivery for Bib Fortuna.<ref name="SWG:R" />

==Behind the scenes==
Niko Brehe appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:R" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Niko Brehe was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
